scope: Native planar DC API and analytical uniform-field checks, including all six line-integral selectors, contour reversal, bent-contour subdivision length and contour clearing. No AC, axisymmetric or paper-replication claim.

input_provenance.geometry: Assumed synthetic 0.04 m by 0.02 m rectangle split at y=0; depth 0.01 m.
input_provenance.material: Assumed explicit linear isotropic mu_r=1, zero conductivity/coercivity/source current/hysteresis, no B-H curve; not fitted.
input_provenance.mu0: Assumed conventional FEMM reference constant 4*pi*1e-7 H/m.
input_provenance.boundary: Derived A_z=A0+Bx*y on the outer perimeter. FEMM manual page 29 equation 2.2 defines prescribed A coefficients.
input_provenance.circuit: Assumed series pickup with I=0 A and two equal-area legs of +10/-10 turns at mean y=+/-0.005 m.
input_provenance.sampling: Assumed four interior points away from the split and exterior edges.

analytical_derivation.field: curl(0,0,A0+Bx*y)=(Bx,0,0); Laplace(A)=0; zero J and mu_r=1.
analytical_derivation.linkage: Sum(turns*depth*mean(A)) = 10*depth*Bx*0.01; equal opposite turns cancel A0.
analytical_derivation.independent_solution_check: Read nodal A and triangles directly from the saved .ans file; check all node potentials and derive element B and total energy independently.

completed.expression: all file and postprocessor close commands returned
